CHAPTER 5 · ITEM 01 / 11

Demand elasticity

Midpoint elasticity中點法彈性

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate price elasticity of demand as the absolute percentage change in quantity demanded divided by the percentage change in price. When comparing two points, use the midpoint formula: |[(Q2−Q1)/((Q1+Q2)/2)] / [(P2−P1)/((P1+P2)/2)]|.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

需求價格彈性用數量百分比變化除價格百分比變化，再取絕對值。中點法以兩點平均數為分母，避免方向影響結果。

Price elasticity of demand is the absolute percentage quantity change divided by percentage price change. Use the average of the two endpoints as each denominator so reversing the direction gives the same result.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：P:10→12, Q:100→80. Ed=(20/90)/(2/11)=11/9≈1.22. 需求有彈性。
